mcqs.question: According to the UN Global Forest Goals Report 2026, what change in global forest cover was recorded between 2015 and 2025?
options: It increased from 4.14 billion hectares to 4.18 billion hectares.
It declined from 4.18 billion hectares to 4.14 billion hectares.
It declined from 190 million hectares to 44 million hectares.
It remained unchanged at 4.18 billion hectares.
mcqs.explanation: Global forest cover declined from 4.18 billion hectares in 2015 to 4.14 billion hectares in 2025, with an average loss of 4.12 million hectares per year. The tempting first option reverses the direction of change; 190 million hectares and 44 million hectares relate to restoration pledges and achievements, not total forest cover.
